scope: Full Git commit history reachable from the exact main HEAD at snapshot; all commits including those not identified as PR merge SHA. Other unmerged/ref-only branches are out of scope.

source.ordering: GitHub API commit history order, newest first; not a guaranteed linear timestamp ordering

sqliteVerificationQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main_commits WHERE merge_pr_number IS NOT NULL;
SELECT commit_sha,commit_date_utc,message_subject FROM main_commits ORDER BY history_position_newest_first DESC LIMIT 1;

classificationSemantics.KNOWN_MERGED_PR_SHA: SHA is exactly the merge_commit_sha of a GitHub PR merged into main; not necessarily a two-parent merge commit.
classificationSemantics.OTHER_MAIN_REACHABLE_COMMIT_PR_ASSOCIATI: Commit is reachable from main and not itself one of the 186 known PR merge SHAs. It may be an individual commit included in a merged PR, direct commit or another git history event; actual PR association has not been established.

limitations: Does not assert that every other commit was pushed directly to main.
Does not cover commits exclusive to unmerged branches or unreachable git history.
Does not prove an exact runtime deployment/attestation for each commit.
Only GitHub records as of the snapshot are registered; data may require new snapshot if main evolves.
SQL scripts are archival import source and have not been executed against production or a remote database.
